content.intro: M1: Introduction to Sustainable Energy System Transformation
content.title: Welcome to the Sustainable Energy Academy!

content.text:
The Sustainable Energy Academy is a training and knowledge-exchange mechanism developed by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) to support the transition to sustainable energy worldwide.

The Sustainable Energy Academy aims to create concrete impact on the ground by providing countries with tailor-made capacity building and a strong global community of experts and practitioners on energy as an enabler for development.

The Academy will connect energy for development 💬️ with nexus topics such as social protection and employment, policy and governance, climate change, energy security, gender equality, finance, technology and data, water management and food resilience.
